scope: Local fixture regression only; no hosted regression, accessibility, crawling or screenshot tests.

browserTests.resolvedFailures: Two forum scenarios expected an empty context but the reused local database retained earlier test comments. A local-only beforeAll now retires that context. All seven forum scenarios passed on recheck.
browserTests.accessibility: Korean and English, light and dark themes, mobile and desktop, resume dialog passed

database.auth: isolated local Auth HTTP double; not a live Supabase account
database.sqlRegression: passed including session sampling across four versions, deterministic restoration, count limits, role permissions and existing database/security/backup checks
database.productionMigration: applied; service-role-only execute permissions and empty search_path verified
database.advisories: No new function security finding. Existing private/content tables intentionally have RLS without browser policies. Supabase Auth leaked-password protection remains disabled.

commands: Targeted typecheck, forum lint and Playwright forum recheck using localEnvironment
notes: The full 2,130-question content audit retains every assertion and has a 15-second timeout for shared workstations.
Windows PowerShell can report exit 1 for redirected nonfatal Node stderr warnings; this was reproduced separately. Test assertion summaries and generated evidence show successful rechecks.
